limitations: No new paid generation; no claim that old generated artifacts were repaired or semantic acceptance passed.
Complete saved-source Read evidence is necessary inspection evidence, not semantic correctness or proof of model attention.

The current read-evidence gate recognizes native complete Read entries; cumulative partial/Bash reads are not treated as equivalent. A too-large draft may require changing the evidence mechanism rather than automatic paid retries.
A draft's read may later leave active context via existing compaction; the gate does not guarantee full text remains attended at final sampling.
Context retirement applies between completed milestones, not a hard cap on growth inside one milestone. Actual model token/credit savings not measured.
The format command guard covers observed direct bun/node relative check-content --format invocation, not every possible shell equivalent.
Source changes are not deployed into the shared running CLI. Validation used a fresh isolated build.
